title: VideoEvidenceService
responsibility: Plans stale video slots and measures finite graph coverage from admitted clip observations.

inputs.name: VideoEvidenceService.constructor.root
inputs.description: Source snapshot directory. Omission passes undefined and uses process.cwd() when constructing the service.

inputs.name: VideoEvidenceService.plan.declaration
inputs.description: JSON video declaration containing the required clips, graph bindings and viewport matrix.

inputs.name: VideoEvidenceService.plan.previous
inputs.description: Previously validated slot candidates; defaults to an empty list. Matching candidates retain their original provenance.

inputs.name: VideoEvidenceService.coverage.declaration
inputs.description: Finite graph declaration whose required state, edge and clip slots are measured.

inputs.name: VideoEvidenceService.coverage.observations
inputs.description: Already admitted clip observations with visible assertion timestamps and freshness supplied by the evidence caller.

inputs.name: clipInputClosure.context
inputs.description: Per-plan source inventory, registered owners, file hashes and dependency caches.

inputs.name: clipInputClosure.clip
inputs.description: One validated clip whose declared and implicit dependencies must be closed.

inputs.name: createClipInputContext.root
inputs.description: Source snapshot directory inventoried once for the complete plan.

inputs.name: readClipInput.context
inputs.description: Per-plan cache that admits only files inside the canonical source root.

inputs.name: readClipInput.path
inputs.description: Safe repository-relative file path whose bytes are read and hashed once.

inputs.name: clipDigest.input
inputs.description: Exact UTF-8 string or original binary bytes to hash with SHA-256.

inputs.name: clipWorkspace.context
inputs.description: Source inventory containing workspace package manifest paths.

inputs.name: clipWorkspace.path
inputs.description: Repository-relative source path used to find its nearest package boundary.

inputs.name: clipInputReferences.context
inputs.description: Per-plan file, workspace and resolved-reference caches.

inputs.name: clipInputReferences.path
inputs.description: Source file scanned for static imports, APIs, styles and media bindings.

inputs.name: clipInputHash.root
inputs.description: Source snapshot path or an already created per-plan discovery and hash context.

inputs.name: clipInputHash.manifest
inputs.description: Video library supplying the selected viewport and relevant graph predicate slices.

inputs.name: clipInputHash.clip
inputs.description: One independently authored clip descriptor with source, script, fixture and checkpoint bindings.

inputs.name: clipInputHash.viewport
inputs.description: Declared viewport identity included in this independent recording slot.

inputs.name: clipInputSlot.context
inputs.description: Shared per-plan registry, dependency, file-hash and recording-tool context.

inputs.name: clipInputSlot.manifest
inputs.description: Validated clip library containing viewport definitions and relevant graph slices.

inputs.name: clipInputSlot.clip
inputs.description: Validated independently recordable clip and checkpoint descriptor.

inputs.name: clipInputSlot.viewport
inputs.description: Declared viewport identity selecting the dimensions hashed into this slot.

inputs.name: graphCoverage.manifest
inputs.description: Validated finite graph and clip declaration.

inputs.name: graphCoverage.observations
inputs.description: Timestamped state and transition assertions from clips admitted by the evidence caller.

outputs.name: VideoEvidenceService.run
outputs.description: Stable video-evidence capability identifier.

outputs.name: VideoEvidenceService.plan
outputs.description: Fresh recording obligations with dependency reasons and unchanged reusable candidate objects retaining their original provenance.

outputs.name: VideoEvidenceService.coverage
outputs.description: Coverage fractions and missing state, edge and clip slots for each finite graph.

outputs.name: clipInputHash
outputs.description: SHA-256 over the clip, viewport, graph slice, full owner/import/style/asset/layout closure, contracts, lockfiles and recording recipe.

outputs.name: graphCoverage
outputs.description: Per-graph state/edge coverage and explicit missing slots; empty viewport coverage is incomplete.

outputs.name: clipInputClosure
outputs.description: Source and contract closure with explicit reasons for conservative widening.

outputs.name: createClipInputContext
outputs.description: Canonical source inventory and caches with one registry read and ffmpeg probe per plan.

outputs.name: readClipInput
outputs.description: Cached SHA-256 and UTF-8 source text from the admitted file bytes.

outputs.name: clipDigest
outputs.description: Lowercase SHA-256 digest of the exact supplied bytes.

outputs.name: clipWorkspace
outputs.description: Nearest repository-relative package directory, or an empty string for the root workspace.

outputs.name: clipInputReferences
outputs.description: Resolved local dependencies and explicit uncertainty requiring conservative source closure.

outputs.name: clipInputSlot
outputs.description: Stable slot identity, input hash, dependency paths and conservative invalidation reasons.

errors.name: ZodError
errors.description: The JSON declaration is malformed or has invalid graph, clip, viewport or checkpoint references.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Video inputs, recording tools, poster media or evidence limits cannot satisfy the declared recording contract.

outputs.description: Stable video-evidence capability identifier.
